tools.name: fair_price
tools.description: Fair price of TapeOut rigs on BNB Chain: median BNB price of recent sales of the same CPU and mining power (12 h, else 24 h, 48 h, 7 d). With cp + vw/uw returns one quote; with no arguments returns rigs listed now with their fair price and discount vs fair, deepest discount first, each with a buy li

tools.name: deals
tools.description: TapeOut mining rigs on BNB Chain listed now below their fair price (median BNB price of recent sales of the same CPU and mining power), only where the fair price rests on at least 3 sales (raise minSales for stricter results; every item shows its sales count). Each item: price, fair, sales, hours, u

tools.name: buy
tools.description: Unsigned transaction to buy one TapeOut rig listed on BNB Chain through the OwlGate router (price + 0.75% OwlGate fee), dry-run from `from`. Use cp + tid from a deals or fair_price item. Returns steps for the buyer to sign and send with their own wallet; OwlGate never signs or holds funds.

tools.name: xl_market
tools.description: TapeOut Rig Bridge vouchers on X Layer (chain 196): each voucher with mining power, BEM/day, holder, open asks and offers (OKB), plus the best voucher by BEM/day. Read-only.

tools.name: xl_build_order
tools.description: Unsigned steps to place an order on the X Layer voucher market (Seaport): kind list (sell one voucher you hold, price in OKB), offer (bid on one voucher, paid in WOKB) or coll (bid on any voucher). The seller pays a 0.75% OwlGate fee on fill. Steps: approve/wrap if needed, sign typed data (free), PO

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: xl_build_order · Private data: deals, buy, xl_build_order · Public sink: buy, xl_build_order · Destructive: buy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: xl_build_order · Private data: deals, buy, xl_build_order · Public sink: buy, xl_build_order · Destructive: buy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
